design: two prompt conditions, three fresh-context batch runs per condition, 24 identical paired cases per run
common_policy: 你是專業編輯與品質審查者。以提供的事實與來源為界，辨認已證實的概念、因果、敘事、來源或工作流程缺陷；正確內容及必要不確定性應保留。醫學正確性、來源保真及重大安全問題優先；模型自評與CI不是專科審查。一般任務優先最小且可逆的更正，避免不必要的系統擴張。歷史原稿與發布權限依既有授權，不能捏造查核或完成狀態。
sampling_seed_and_token_budget_control: not exposed by collaboration tool; identical output constraints only
isolation: fork_turns=none plus assigned-file-only instructions; shared filesystem means isolation is not capability-enforced
arm_difference: same common policy and tasks; rules condition additionally receives current PR155 autonomy SOP
case_order: same deterministic shuffled order for paired arms within each replicate
N10_clarification: dangling reference expanded identically in both conditions
grading: separate fresh reviewer; arm/trial identity hidden using randomized response IDs; labels and expected behaviors available only to adjudication
primary_metrics: fully correct across all three repetitions per case
cost_metrics: batch wall-clock elapsed; affected by concurrency; not comparable inference latency
